description:
Free local tool. Records a tool call execution in the agent memory database (SQLite FTS5). Auto-call after any paid or significant tool call to build searchable history. No x402 charge.

SAP MCP execution guidance: Intent: SAP MCP tool workflow. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required.

inputSchema.description: Record Tool Call input schema. Intent: SAP MCP tool workflow. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required. Use exact field names from this schema; do not guess aliases or include private key material.

costUsd.description: x402 cost in USD if the tool was paid.

toolName.description: MCP tool name that was called.

name: sap_memory_record

content.description: MCP content blocks returned to the caller.

text.description: Human-readable JSON or text returned by the tool.

type.description: MCP content block type, usually text.

isError.description: True when the tool result represents an application-level error.

title: Record Tool Call
